A four-plot Escalator: wide waves and a line with four gaps.
A round beyond the maximum round uses the budget of the maximum round.
arch_fortress hard threat, round 5, party size 4: four ring sets, one Core per plot.
arch_boss boss threat, round 5, party size 4: one Core per plot, bosses included.
arch_boss_brood boss threat, round 5, party size 2: 30 percent of the stronghold budget is set aside and split over 2 Cores x 3 thresholds into six bursts.
arch_boss_brood boss threat, round 10, party size 1: the largest wave needs a strength conversion, which the bursts share.
arch_boss_brood boss threat, round 14, party size 4: twelve bursts (4 Cores x 3 thresholds) of two units each.
A round 5 boss Linked Cores stronghold for party size 2: two Cores at their usual positions, plus stronghold.sharedHealth, the sum of their health.
A round 9 boss Linked Cores stronghold for party size 3.
A round 14 boss Linked Cores stronghold for party size 4 (strength conversion on the waves).
A round 7 boss Pylons stronghold for a solo party: three pylons around the Core at Chebyshev distance 2 to 4 in different sectors, health from a quarter of the stronghold budget (at least 1 each).
A round 12 boss Pylons stronghold for party size 3: three pylons per Core, each in its own plot, sorted by (y, x), the pylon budget split over all nine.
A round 30 boss Pylons stronghold for party size 4: twelve pylons with large health, the strength conversion on the waves.

A round 9 boss Warlord for a solo party: 35 percent of each wave's budget cannot buy a Golem at 600 percent health (nor at 100), so every wave's champion is a plain Golem (healthPercent 100) leading the wave; the rest of the budget buys the Boss composition.

A round 12 boss Warlord for a solo party: the champion's health percent grows with the wave size (100 in the small waves, 114 and 142 in the last two) because the share buys less than the 600 percent; strength conversion on the other units (the champion counts toward the cap).
A round 20 boss Warlord for a solo party: the share buys the full 600 percent in the last two waves, the earlier ones are scaled down (280 to 548 percent).
A round 30 boss Warlord for party size 4: every wave has four champions (one per plot) at the full 600 percent; the cap (12 per plot) leaves 11 per plot for the other units.
